university.name: Multimedia University Malaysia (MMU)
university.overview: Multimedia University has been in the education field for more than 20 years and has undergone countless changes, but it has always maintained its vision and mission to achieve the highest performance standards in teaching and the services we provide to students, faculty, and the community. As an educational institution, Multimedia University (MMU) is committed to achieving its vision of higher customer satisfaction through continuous improvement of an effective quality management system that meets the requirements of ISO 9001:2015 and applicable regulatory requirements.
university.accreditation: ISO 9001:2015 certification; first private university approved by the Malaysian government
university.ranking_highlight: One of the top five universities where major ICT participants prefer graduate employment (Gartner and MSC Malaysia study)

entry_requirements.subject_requirements: Minimum Grade C in at least three (3) subjects inclusive of Mathematics and a Pass in English
entry_requirements.other_qualifications: Contact educational consultants or submit application for Admission assessment for other qualifications (UEC, Foundation, STAM, etc.)

courses.overview: The Diploma in Information Technology at Multimedia University Malaysia is a 2-year program that equips students with essential ICT knowledge and skills. They gain technical expertise in systems analysis, programming, web design, and networking. The program also emphasizes professional ethics and enhances communication and teamwork skills. Graduates can pursue related degree programs and have various career opportunities in IT, including roles like IT support specialists, software developers, and web designers.
